title: Find patients who have at least one laboratory record with abnormal IgM lev
question: Find patients who have at least one laboratory record with abnormal IgM levels (≤40 or ≥400) and elevated total cholesterol (≥250). For these patients, return their ID, sex, age at first hospital visit, and the number of such qualifying lab records. Only include patients whose first hospital visit occurred between 1980 and 1995.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  P."XCL_058" AS patient_id,
  P."XCL_059" AS sex,
  P."XCL_062" AS age_at_first_visit,
  COUNT(L."XCL_014") AS qualifying_lab_count
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L
  ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE (L."XCL_044" <= 40 OR L."XCL_044" >= 400)
  AND L."XCL_026" >= 250
  AND P."XCL_062" BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY P."XCL_058", P."XCL_059", P."XCL_062"
